During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''conspiracy''' to use the black market to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] supplies onto [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] was formed. At the time, most supplying activity to the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]] was frozen as a negative reaction to Mandalore's neutral stance in the war. The plot was led by [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], who was also the acting leader of the government and the second most powerful man on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Origins==
The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Mandalore had declared itself neutral with the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming a prominent member of the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]], an organization which represented over 1,500<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> star systems wishing to stay out of the armed conflict. Led by Mandalorian Duchess Satine Kryze, the council&mdash;along with other activities&mdash;attempted to counter the emerging [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] movement.<ref name="TMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>

[[File:CouncilOfNeutralSystems.png|thumb|left|250px|The Council of Neutral Systems, a Sundari-based body uniting various factions.]]
The declaration of neutrality left Mandalore in isolation, as neither of the two primary belligerents provided supply for the planet.<ref name="CO" /> To ensure the continuing importation of vital goods and resources, Prime Minister [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] contacted [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to establish a [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="TA" />

==Activities==
===Tea smuggling===
{{Quote|Where do you get the tea?''"<br />"''From Mooga. The Commerce Guild controls it.|Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] inquiring [[Siddiq/Legends|Siddiq]]|<ref name="CO" />}}
[[File:Ardees_Beverage_tea_girl.png|thumb|right|Tea incorrectly diluted with slabin caused several poisoning cases among schoolchildren.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Corruption Date" /> the conspirators imported [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]] from [[Mooga/Legends|Mooga]] for [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] schoolchildren.<ref name="CO" /> The [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]]<ref name="CO-EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref> smugglers, led by [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]],<ref name="Shop">{{TCWA|set=Tee Va}}</ref> bribed an [[Unidentified Mandalorian customs official/Legends|official]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] and established a facility in the spaceport, where they diluted the tea with [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]. The drinks were then sold to [[Sundari Mandalorian school/Legends|several schools]] through an employee of a [[Unidentified Mandalorian shipping company/Legends|shipping company]] called [[Siddiq/Legends|Siddiq]] and the corrupted [[Unidentified Sundari school superintendent/Legends|superintendent]] of the school. However, the slabin caused an epidemic among pupils, so Galactic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] began to investigate the matter. After persuading the [[Unidentified Mandalorian police captain (Sundari)|police captain]] to aid them, the two [[Gender/Legends|women]], along with several policemen, stumbled across the Moogans' compound, and a [[Skirmish at the Sundari docks/Legends|firefight]] broke out, which resulted in the arrest of the smugglers and the corrupt police aiding them. The warehouse was eventually burned down.<ref name="CO" />
